purpose: Search hints for manual source-path-decision-constraint review, not vulnerability or protection verdicts.
matching: Patterns are literal search hints; resolve bindings, execution context and reachable paths before using a match.

sources.name: page input
sources.verify: Identify the actual event/page entry and attacker-controlled fields; resolve aliases and overwrites.

sources.name: storage
sources.verify: Find writers and the actual trust boundary; storage alone does not establish the value's origin.

sources.name: network response
sources.verify: Resolve the response binding, sender and downstream consumers.

sources.name: clipboard
sources.verify: Identify the returned value and reachable consumer.

sources.name: cloud event
sources.verify: Resolve the cloud-function entry, caller controls and trusted platform context.

sinks.name: network
sinks.verify: Resolve the final destination, execution principal, payload and response use; a request is not automatically SSRF.

sinks.name: cloud operation
sinks.verify: Resolve the function or collection, deployed authorization rules and resource ownership.

sinks.name: webview
sinks.verify: Trace the final URL, redirects, message origin and privileged message handlers.

sinks.name: file
sinks.verify: Resolve filesystem roots, canonical paths, accessible files and actual side effects.

sinks.name: render
sinks.verify: Establish the actual rendering context and component execution restrictions before alleging injection.

sinks.name: navigation
sinks.verify: Resolve destination and parameters, then identify any security-sensitive action at the target.

sinks.name: backend operation
sinks.verify: Confirm the binding is a real database/command API, the runtime is reachable and controlled values enter executable syntax.

sinks.name: logging
sinks.verify: Identify actual sensitive values, recipients and access conditions; logging text alone does not prove disclosure.

guards.name: identity decision hint
guards.verify: Identify trusted identity provenance, ownership/tenant checks, enforced branches and any client-controlled override. These words do not establish authorization.

guards.name: allowlist hint
guards.verify: Inspect the actual permitted semantic values, normalization, failure behavior and coverage of all paths.

guards.name: encoding hint
guards.verify: Inspect the implementation, final decoding and sink context. A function name or encoding step does not establish protection.

guards.name: parameterization hint
guards.verify: Confirm real API semantics and separation of data from executable structure at the final operation.

transforms.name: decoding
transforms.verify: Track the parsed output and whether validation occurred before or after decoding.

transforms.name: composition
transforms.verify: Resolve operands and properties rather than assuming text proximity proves a path.

transforms.name: serialization
transforms.verify: Track later parsing and the final security decision; serialization does not establish authorization or sanitization.
